abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Cindara
abilities.description: Melee basic attack chain dealing 61.0/63.2/65.6/68.1/70.7/73.4/76.2/79.2/82.3/85.5/88.8/92.2/95.8/99.5/103.3/107.2/111.2/115.4 (+80% physical power) physical damage. Chain Attack Rate: 2x/2x/1.05x. Chain Damage: 0.5x/0.5x/1.1x. Third Strike: Restores 5 Energy On-Hit. Increased to 10 against Heroes. Empowered: Equip your Lantern for 1 attack, slamming it forward in a line.

abilities.name: Last Light
abilities.description: Scarlett uses Energy instead of Mana: Max Energy: 200.0/400.0/600.0/800.0/1000.0/1200.0/1400.0/1600.0/1800.0/2000.0/2200.0/2400.0/2600.0/2800.0/3000.0/3200.0/3400.0/3600.0. Energy Regen: 10.0/20.0/30.0/40.0/50.0/60.0/70.0/80.0/90.0/100.0/110.0/120.0/130.0/140.0/150.0/160.0/170.0/180.0 per second. On Takedown: Scarlett restores 100 Energy immediately. Scarlett also converts every 35 Bonus Mana she acquires into 1 Physical Power.

abilities.name: Ashen Vow
abilities.description: Scarlett channels for a short duration, before swinging her Lantern around her, dealing 50.0/75.0/100.0/125.0/150.0 (+60% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies in the area. Outer Edge hits deal 25.0/50.0/75.0/100.0/125.0 (+100% physical power) additional damage and Slow targets hit by 35.0/37.5/40.0/42.5/45.0% for 1.25s. Outer Edge hits on Enemy Heroes or Camp Leaders Empower Scarlett's next Cindara attack for 4s, causing it to now damage all Enemies in a line in front of her, dealing 15 (+12% physical power) (+2.0/2.5/3.0/3.5/4.0% Target's Max Health) bonus damage, and restoring 35.0/45.0/55.0 Energy upon hitting an Enemy Hero or Camp Leader. Empowered Cindara damage is reduced by 50% against Minions and is capped against Monsters. Ablaze: Empowered Cindara's bonus damage is increased by 1.5x.

abilities.name: First Intent
abilities.description: Scarlett dashes forward with a decisive, fiery strike that deals 65.0/85.0/105.0/125.0/145.0 (+80% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies in her path and receives a 20.0/70.0/120.0/170.0/220.0 (+40.0/45.0/50.0/55.0/60.0% physical power) Shield for 3s. Each time Scarlett hits an Enemy Hero or Camp Leader with First Intent she refreshes her Shield's duration and increases its size by 60%, and restores 50 Energy.

abilities.name: Minueta
abilities.description: Scarlett twirls in her current movement direction, with its speed increasing based on current momentum. Scarlett then stabs forward 3 times, with each dealing 21.0/31.0/41.0/51.0/61.0 (+24.0/28.5/33.0/37.5/42.0% physical power) physical damage. The final stab deals up to 100% bonus damage based on the Target's Missing Health. Stabs benefit from Lifesteal and can Critically Strike at 60% effectiveness. Ablaze: Number of Stabs is increased to 4, dealing 15% more damage overall.

abilities.name: Swan Song
abilities.description: Scarlett strikes forward with her lantern, with its chain Restraining the first Enemy Hero hit for 1.4s, and Slowing nearby Enemies by 65% for 1s. Scarlett then backflips into the air, becoming Unstoppable for the duration of the Restrain, and ignites her Blade before striking down at her target, dealing 180.0/280.0/350.0 (+100% physical power) physical damage. Enemies near the Restrained Hero also receive 100% of the strike's damage. After striking, Scarlett's Blade remains Ablaze for 8.0/10.0/12.0s, granting her +150 Basic Attack Range, 5 Energy Regen, 20.0/32.0/44.0 (+12% physical power) Physical Power, and enhancing certain abilities for the duration.

augments.name: Scarlet Dawn
augments.description: Ability, Empowered Cindara, and Third Strike hits on Heroes/Camp Leaders reduce First Intent's Cooldown by 8%, reduced to 5% for Minueta hits.

augments.name: Coup De Grace
augments.description: Swan Song marks the Restrained target. If they die within 8.0/10.0/12.0s, Ablaze extends by 5s, and a fiery zone appears beneath them for 5s that heals Yourself and Allies by 100.0/150.0/200.0 (+65% physical power) each second.

augments.name: Volcaic Slam
augments.description: Empowered Cindara leaves behind a rupture that erupts after 0.5s. The eruption deals 20 (+4 per Level) (+25% physical power) Damage to Enemies and Slows by 40% for 1.25s.
